## Phillips 66 (PSX) `[Energy]`
- U.S. gasoline inventories increased by approximately 3.5 million barrels on October 15, 2026, versus expectations for a draw; gasoline futures fell afterward, while a major refining-crack-spread index declined approximately 5.8% that day. (Quiver Quantitative, Oct 15 2026; publish time not stated)[1]
- Mizuho downgraded Phillips 66 to Neutral from Outperform on October 8, 2026, citing limited remaining upside after the refining-stock rally; its price target was reported at $300. (Quiver Quantitative, Oct 15 2026; publish time not stated)[1][6]
- Wells Fargo analyst Sam Margolin maintained an Overweight rating and raised the price target to $345 from $335, while citing investor concerns about the duration of crude and refined-product markets and retaining a $70 WTI forecast for 2027. (Markets Insider, Oct 14 2026, updated Oct 15 2026; publish time not stated)[2]
- Barclays analyst Theresa Chen maintained Equal Weight and raised the price target to $282 from $216 on October 12, 2026. (Ad-Hoc-News, Oct 14 2026; publish time not stated)[3]
- Phillips 66 disclosed a possible Bayway refinery labor disruption after union employees overwhelmingly authorized a strike ahead of contract expiration; a strike could affect operations and costs. [report] (MarketBeat, Oct 14 2026, updated Oct 15 2026; publish time not stated)[8]
- Phillips 66’s third-quarter 2026 results are scheduled for October 28, 2026, before a noon-ET webcast. (Ad-Hoc-News, Oct 14 2026; publish time not stated)[3]
- No company-specific catalyst found in window.
